column12: an intent row out of the form of N1.5
column13: 503 at the readers; failures at the controller

column12: a unit heavier than any capacity; a group without room; nobody reaches the labels

column12: the full key `<sub>/placement/<id>` of a member is longer than the key limit of the store

a placement row decided by a newer manifest

column12: turn is busy; its version is younger than TURN_TERM
column13: no changing pass, this is not failures
column15: a retry on the next pass

column12: turn/intent does not read; the prepared intent/assignment exceed the ceiling
column13: failures and the reason; without a new admission
column15: restore the service row or reduce the group/load; do not split the decision

column12: guard turn refused, the placement write is unknown or a conflict arose
column13: stop the current plan; do not accept new decisions
column15: confirm the barrier of the own version of turn and recover the intent; if holder is someone else's — wait

column12: grows: no positive capacity of a worker and capacity.default = 0
column13: short with the shortage, withheld: no positive capacity estimate; no order
column15: name a positive capacity/default; there is no division by zero

column12: grows: no candidate server (labels, drain, decommission, no base, no room, the numbers ran out)
column15: raise the base, free memory or numbers, give labels

column12: grows: servers: distinct, the place from the heartbeat — there is no free place, on each server a live suitable one without a place or a probe in flight, or the probe process of this pass is already ordered (N3 «shortage()»)
column13: the growth is no more than one probe process per pass; the remainder — withheld, the units — in `unplaceable` with `why` `no free <place_by>`
column15: give a place (a row of the table of places) on a server of the role

column12: grows: the server did not raise the order within WANT_GRACE
column13: want(s) := 1 + \|live numbers ∩ {2…want(s)}\| (N3 «withdraw on deadline»), `raise_failed`, the alarm `workers.raise_failed`; the order — on the next candidate

column12: WRITE_CONFLICT_LIMIT consecutive conflicts on one logical write, by forms/runtime-constants.tsv
